# ADR-0104: the figure sheet is carried byte for byte

## Context

The first portal shipped with its own figure.css. Present took that file
and changed two selectors for the review layout, and the March skin work
changed the portal's file again. By June the two files differed in eleven
places and a figure drawn for one rendered differently on the other, so we
tried twice to keep them aligned by review and each time they drifted
within a month. A figure declared once must render the same wherever the
kit is carried. No one reviewing a product's sheet can hold eleven
differences in their head.

## Decision

The kit's `figure.css` is carried byte for byte by every product that
carries the kit. A product sheet that differs by one byte fails the drift
check. A product adds figure CSS of its own only in a separate sheet loaded
after the kit's.

## Consequences

Every product renders a figure the same way, and figure work happens once,
in the kit. A product cannot tune a figure locally. A change to the sheet
is a kit release that lands in every product at once. The drift check runs
in every product's CI.

## Alternatives considered

A shared package was dropped: it adds a build step the kit promises not to
need. A per-product override block was dropped: the eleven differences came
from exactly that.

## Architecture impact

None.
